correctness.rationale: Walsh diagonalization yields exact r,s and t,u integrals for every edge-pair orbit. The rank-two inverse of L-bb^T-cc^T on the mean-zero subspace gives the claimed Kirchhoff index increment with positive determinant. Both cross moments are jointly positive after orientation and strictly decrease with separation. Comparison of incident vs opposite-square configurations follows via monotone weighted expectations; the product t_T u_T exceeds t_P u_P at dimension 5 by 241/491520 and ratios increase thereafter; direct exact rational comparisons give 1/35 and 299/10540 at dimensions 3 and 4. Strictness and the count follow. The exact standalone checker verified 7503 identities including full edge-pair enumeration Q3–Q5 and independent inverse checks Q3–Q4; this is auxiliary to the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural and consequential robustness metric in electrical or noisy-consensus networks is the total pairwise resistance after simultaneous failures. The theorem determines every worst two-edge failure and its exact damage for all dimensions, contrasting with a distinct spectral-gap robustness objective which selects a disjoint geometric pattern. It provides structural rather than arbitrary numerical data for a canonical large scalable graph family.
